patch_description: Replace the redundant RY+RZ+CZ_line+RZ ansatz (24 params/block) with a compact RY+CNOT_ring+RX design (16 params/block). The original design wastes 8 parameters per block because CZ commutes with RZ, making the pre-CZ and post-CZ RZ layers effectively redundant. The new design uses: (1) RY rotations for Y-axis control, (2) CNOT in a ring topology (even pairs then odd pairs) for richer entanglement than the linear CZ chain, and (3) RX rotations that don't commute with either the CNOT entanglement or the IsingZZ feature map. This reduces total parameters from 146 to 98 while maintaining or improving expressivity.
